# Jarvis Mark 1 — Realtime Backup

Frozen snapshot of the OpenAI Realtime voice Jarvis (saved automatically).

**Do not edit this folder** — it's your restore point if the Ollama test build changes things.

To run this backup copy:
```powershell
cd backup\jarvis-mark1-realtime
npm install
npm run dev
```

To refresh this backup from the current main project:
```powershell
npm run backup
```
